source.name: Relicbox
source.description:
Courier consumable: Click to open
Select one from three random relics to your inventory.
source.lore: Long long ago, a dragon appeared and took away all relic treasures...
notes: Relic equipped will expire at next relic round.
Exclusive, new relic will replace the former one.
